name: draw2-v1
description: A new memory set for the routing gate: one made-up user, Noor Haddad, a lead designer at a telehealth startup, her team, a job change, a corrected launch date and a trip to Portugal, in the style of the store fixture. Authored before any question about it existed.

memories.content: Noor Haddad is a lead product designer at Lumen Health, a telehealth startup with about 120 employees.
Noor joined Lumen Health in February 2025 as a senior designer and was promoted to lead designer in August 2026.
Before Lumen Health, Noor worked at Brightline Studio in Austin from 2021 to January 2025.
Noor lives in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Noor moved there from Austin in January 2025 for the Lumen Health job.
Noor's partner is Idris, a high school chemistry teacher. Idris is allergic to walnuts.
Noor has a gray cat named Pepper, adopted in 2025. Pepper eats at 7 am and 6 pm.
Noor prefers dark roast coffee and stops drinking it after 3 pm.
Noor likes Figma and Linear for work and dislikes Sketch.
Always give Noor timelines in weeks, not sprints.
Assistant noted Noor's working style: visual first, wants a sketch or mock before long explanations, dislikes slide decks.
Noor goes bouldering at Granite Gym three evenings a week.
Noor's sister Lina lives in Lisbon and works as a ceramicist.
Lumen Health builds its product on React and Postgres, hosts it on Google Cloud, and tracks work in Linear.
Lumen Health decided to redesign the Patient Portal and name the new design system Atlas.
The Patient Portal redesign has a budget of 140,000 USD and a team of five.
The usability test of the Patient Portal prototype scored 71 on the System Usability Scale, and the target is 85.
The Patient Portal launch is scheduled for Friday 2026-11-06.

memories.speaker: Sven Larsen
memories.content: I checked the clinic calendar and the launch collides with the flu-season freeze. I want it moved two weeks.
Correction: the Patient Portal launch moved from 2026-11-06 to Friday 2026-11-20 after Sven found the flu-season freeze.
Noor rejected Sketch for the Atlas design system because Lumen Health's engineers only support Figma tokens.
Noor agreed to use Storybook for documenting Atlas components.
Assistant compared Storybook with Zeroheight: Storybook stays in the codebase, while Zeroheight is easier for non-engineers to edit.
Noor presents the Atlas roadmap at the company all-hands on 2026-10-29.
Noor's design critique is every Thursday at 2:00 pm Central time.
Noor's manager is Elena Voss, Head of Design at Lumen Health.
Marcus Chen is a design engineer on the platform team. Tilda Okoro is the user researcher.
Noor has a 1:1 with Elena every Monday at 11:00 Central time.
Noor mentors Marcus Chen in a weekly 45 minute session on Fridays.
Tilda is on leave from 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-26, so Marcus covers the usability sessions.
Noor prefers written design reviews over live walkthroughs.
Noor likes leading the weekly stand-up and runs it most Tuesdays.
Correction: leading the stand-up drains Noor. Noor prefers a 10 minute async update and not a live meeting.

memories.speaker: Elena Voss
memories.content: I would like you to own the accessibility audit this quarter. It would be strong evidence for your promotion to principal.
Noor first declined to lead the accessibility audit, citing the Atlas workload.
Noor accepted leading the accessibility audit on 2026-10-15, on the condition that Tilda joins the audit.
Noor and Idris plan a trip to Portugal in June 2027 to visit Lina and celebrate her birthday.
Correction: the Portugal trip moved earlier, to 2027-05-08 through 2027-05-22, because Lina's pottery fair is in mid May.
They chose Lisbon, Porto, Sintra, and Évora. They dropped Faro to save time.
Noor prefers trains to rental cars and wants a Navegante pass for Lisbon.
Because of Idris's walnut allergy, Noor needs a Portuguese allergy card for restaurants.
The Portugal trip budget is 6,200 EUR, not including flights.
Noor booked TAP flights from Minneapolis to Lisbon departing 2027-05-08.
Noor signed up for a bouldering competition at Granite Gym on 2026-11-14.
Noor sprained a wrist on 2026-10-03 and is skipping hard problems for three weeks.
Assistant suggested a taper plan for the competition: two light sessions the week before and a rest day on 2026-11-13.
Noor reads literary fiction. The current book is Piranesi.
